Reply in your reviewer's language

Read every review and reply in the language it was written: 100+ languages, tone intact, no copy-paste translator.

Find similar reviews

Surface every review that echoes the same complaint, with a match score, so one great reply covers a hundred.

Analytics that explain

Rating trends, response rate, and an AI executive summary that names the themes behind the numbers.

Signal: reviews, ranked by what to fix

Argus doesn't just answer reviews, it tells you what to fix. Recurring asks rank into one evidence-backed feed, loudest first, each linked to the reviews behind it.

Alerts before it spreads

Get pinged in Slack, Telegram, Discord, or your own webhook the moment a rating drops or a negative review lands.

Automations with a leash

Rules by rating, keyword, language, or store. Auto-draft everything; auto-publish only what you trust.

Learns as you approve

Every edit you make teaches Argus your style. Approvals get faster, drafts get closer, week over week.

The loop

Lands. Drafts. Ships.

The 1-star that used to sit ignored for a week now gets a thoughtful, on-brand reply in minutes.

  1. 01

    It lands in one feed

    Every new review syncs in from both stores (the App Store and Google Play), tagged by rating, language, and sentiment.

  2. 02

    Argus drafts the reply

    Grounded in your voice and everything it learned about your app (from its store listing to your marketing page), written in the reviewer's own language.

  3. 03

    You approve, it ships

    Publish back to the store in a click, or set a rule and let trusted replies go on their own.

  4. 04

    It tells you what to fix first

    As the same request recurs, Signal ranks it into an evidence-backed feed: reviews, ranked by what to fix first. Export an entry to Notion or Sheets (Jira soon) and answer it in the product itself.

Agentic tools

Now it takes an AI agent.

Reply Argus is a remote MCP server, so any AI agent can run your review desk (search, analytics, draft and publish), scoped to your workspace, with your approval by default. One-click in Claude, or wire the raw endpoint into any MCP client.

Signal · reviews, ranked by what to fix

Stop reading reviews. Start ranking them.

Argus doesn't just answer reviews. Signal ranks the recurring asks into one feed, reviews ranked by what to fix first, each entry linked to the reviews behind it. It's how you turn your reviews into a product roadmap you can export to Notion or Google Sheets (Jira coming soon). Reactive becomes proactive.

Why Argus

Every unanswered review is a customer who thinks no one's listening. Argus answers them all, in their own language, before you wake.

Teams & agencies

Built for teams and the agencies
that run reviews for them.

Invite your team, scope each teammate to the apps they should touch, and keep the publish button yours. Seats are included on every plan. You're priced on replies, not people.

For agencies

Invite

Bring the team in

Add teammates as Publishers, Drafters, or free unlimited Viewers. Seats are bundled on every plan, never billed per head.

Scope

Scope to the right app

Assign each teammate only the apps they should see. A Drafter on your fitness app never sees your finance app.

Approve

Keep the publish button yours

Make someone a Drafter and nothing goes live until a Publisher or Admin approves it. Maker, meet checker.

FAQ

Reply Argus, answered.

Everything you might want to know before you start. Still unsure? Just begin, the Free plan needs no card.
